scope: UK vaping regulation and excise milestones relevant to Vaping26 research.
notice: This is a research timeline, not legal advice. Effective requirements must be checked against current legislation and official guidance.

milestones.title: Vaping Products Duty approval applications opened
milestones.summary: HMRC opened applications for relevant Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps approvals.

milestones.title: Tobacco and Vapes Bill granted Royal Assent
milestones.authority: Department of Health and Social Care
milestones.summary: The Tobacco and Vapes Bill became law following Royal Assent on 29 April 2026.

milestones.title: UK-wide tobacco and vapes packaging, appearance and display consultation launched
milestones.authority: Department of Health and Social Care
milestones.summary: The consultation seeks views on regulations using powers in the Tobacco and Vapes Act 2026, including vape packaging, appearance and display measures; no immediate legal change is implied by consultation proposals.

milestones.title: Vaping Products Duty and Duty Stamps Force of Law Notice updated
milestones.summary: HMRC published updated force-of-law notices under the Finance Act 2026 and related 2026 regulations.

milestones.title: Duty-stamp requirements begin for newly released liable products
milestones.summary: Liable products released onto the UK market from 1 October 2026 are subject to the new duty-stamp regime, with transitional rules for older stock.

milestones.title: Vaping Products Duty starts
milestones.summary: A flat Vaping Products Duty of £2.20 per 10 ml is scheduled to take effect for liable vaping liquid.

milestones.title: General retail grace period for unstamped pre-October stock ends
milestones.summary: HMRC guidance states that from 1 April 2027 all vaping products outside duty suspension must have a duty stamp attached.

milestones.title: Government intended start date for ending vaping and nicotine product advertising and sponsorship
milestones.authority: Department of Health and Social Care
milestones.summary: DHSC states an intention for the Tobacco and Vapes Act advertising and sponsorship restrictions for vaping and nicotine products to come into force across the UK from 1 June 2027; commencement should be rechecked before treating this as an operative legal date.
